discontinuities.issue: PcbCanonicalModel computes custom JSON stringify hash without binding to EngineeringIdentity identityId or canonicalRevisionId.
discontinuities.impact: PCB modifications generate local hash changes that are not registered as revision increments in Core RevisionEngine.

discontinuities.issue: NodalCircuitSolver computes voltage drops and branch currents on floating CircuitModel objects without domainRevisionBindings.
discontinuities.impact: Circuit simulation results can be presented for an old schematic revision without stale result detection.

discontinuities.issue: RouteWaypoint 3D coordinates are floating numeric vectors with no topological link to Mechanical Enclosure B-Rep face/edge IDs.
discontinuities.impact: Mechanical enclosure dimensional edits do not invalidate or flag harness routes as out-of-date.

discontinuities.issue: MultidomainPcbIntegrationEngine performs electrothermal & MNA coupling in-memory without propagating stale status downstream when PCB component placements mutate.
discontinuities.impact: Thermal/electrical coupling reports do not trigger invalidation of downstream FEM/CFD boundary condition manifests.

discontinuities.issue: FEMCore executes stiffness matrix and displacement solves without checking or requiring SimulationAuthorityInternal seal or executionAuthority token.
discontinuities.impact: FEM simulation results can be generated from unverified or tampered mesh input files.

discontinuities.issue: Navier-Stokes fluid flow calculations execute on raw CFD meshes without verifying inputManifestHash or binding to canonical CAD B-Rep revision.
discontinuities.impact: Fluid dynamics flow fields can be presented as valid for a superseded geometry revision.
